name: TISSUE CULTURE RACK
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Tissue Culture Rack is a highly specialized environmental storage system engineered for the optimized growth and propagation of plant tissue and cell cultures in botanical laboratories, agriculture research facilities, and biotechnology industries. It provides uniformly distributed luminescence, optimal ventilation, and customizable shelving options to replicate the precise lighting spectrum required for robust photosynthesis and in-vitro development.
features: Sturdy framework constructed from premium Mild Steel (Powder Coated) or Stainless Steel
Configurable racking system available in four, five, or six shelf options
Independent switching arrangement for lighting in every single shelf
Equipped with energy-saving 4 x 40 watt fluorescent lights for uniform growth
Supplementary 4 x 25 watt incandescent lamps per shelf to increase lux intensity and spectrum radiation
Mounted on heavy-duty castor wheels for effortless mobility across the laboratory

specifications.Structure Material: Available in Mild Steel (Powder Coated) or Stainless Steel
specifications.Number of Racks: Options available: Four, Five, or Six racks
specifications.Primary Lighting: 4 x 40 Watt fluorescent tubes per shelf
specifications.Secondary Lighting: 4 x 25 Watt incandescent lamps per shelf for spectrum enhancement
specifications.Lighting Control: Individual switching arrangements installed on each shelf
specifications.Power Supply: Works on 230 ± 10 V / 50 Hz power supply
